description: The ratio requirement (26 CFR 1.45-8(c)): on each day, for one employer and one occupation on the job site, the number of apprentices may not exceed what the registered program’s apprentice-to-journeyworker ratio allows for the journeyworkers present (or the ratio for the facility’s area). Give the program ratio and, for each day, the headcounts of journeyworkers and apprentices on site (the controlling input) with each apprentice’s hours; the tool returns the apprentice hours that count toward the percentage and the excess hours that do not (they stay in total labor hours and must be paid the full journeyworker prevailing rate: 1.45-7(b)(7)(iii), 29 CFR 5.5(a)(4)(i)). With hours only and no headcounts it prorates on hours, marked as an interpretation.

days.description: One entry per day for one employer and occupation.

apprentice_hours.description: Hours worked that day by registered apprentices in the occupation.

apprentice_hours_by_person.description: Each apprentice’s hours that day (one number per apprentice); replaces apprentice_hours and apprentices when given, and lets the excess be measured per person.

apprentices.description: Headcount of apprentices on site that day.

journeyworker_hours.description: Hours worked that day by journeyworkers in the occupation (a working foreperson or owner who is a qualified journeyworker counts here).

journeyworkers.description: Headcount of journeyworkers on site that day: the regulation’s test (1.45-8(c)(2)).

ratio_apprentices.description: Apprentices side of the program ratio (default 1).

ratio_journeyworkers.description: Journeyworkers side of the program ratio (default 1). A 1:1 program = 1 and 1; 2 apprentices per journeyworker = 2 and 1.

name: check_daily_ratio
title: Daily apprentice-to-journeyworker ratio
